item.title: Thesis submitted at ÉTS
item.description: I submitted my master’s thesis at ÉTS. The work is real-time simulation of surface wear, at the meeting point of physical simulation, contact, and graphics rendering.

item.title: Master's thesis — contact–appearance coupling for wear in texture space
item.description: Couplage contact-apparence pour l’usure de surfaces microstructurées en simulation interactive — my ÉTS master’s thesis (English abstract title: Visual Appearance Evolution from Wear on Microstructured Surfaces in Texture Space). Directed by Sheldon Andrews, defended 14 August 2026. The core idea: give material maps a persistent local memory of contact. Body travel alone cannot predict where wear shows up.
